questions.q: The value of π (pi) is approximately?
questions.exp: The value of π (pi) is approximately 3.14159. It is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Pi is an irrational and transcendental number.

questions.q: What is the square root of 144?
questions.exp: The square root of 144 is 12, because 12 × 12 = 144. The square root is the inverse operation of squaring a number.

questions.q: Which number is neither prime nor composite?
questions.exp: 1 is neither prime nor composite. A prime number has exactly 2 factors (1 and itself), while a composite number has more than 2 factors. 1 has only 1 factor.

questions.q: A triangle with all three sides equal is called?
questions.exp: A triangle with all three sides equal is called an equilateral triangle. All angles in an equilateral triangle are also equal, each measuring 60°.

questions.q: The sum of angles in a triangle is?
questions.exp: The sum of all interior angles in a triangle is always 180°. This is a fundamental theorem of Euclidean geometry.

questions.q: What is the LCM of 4 and 6?
questions.exp: The Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 4 and 6 is 12. LCM is the smallest positive integer that is divisible by both numbers.

questions.q: The formula for the area of a circle is?
questions.exp: The area of a circle is πr², where r is the radius and π is approximately 3.14159. The circumference of a circle is 2πr.

questions.q: How many sides does a pentagon have?
questions.exp: A pentagon has 5 sides and 5 angles. The sum of interior angles of a pentagon is 540°. A regular pentagon has all sides and angles equal.

questions.q: The Pythagoras theorem states: In a right triangle, a² + b² = ?
questions.exp: The Pythagoras theorem states that in a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse (c) equals the sum of squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².
